name: Walk to nine
summary: Everyone's walk to their first class as a campus map: routes from the apartment across the quad to each building in each walker's color, with leave times. Play the morning and the faces walk at their real times; tap 'Walk with' to leave together with someone heading out about when you do.
useWhen: who's walking to campus tomorrow, i have a 9am at larkin
anyone want to walk to class together in the morning
when does everyone leave for their 9ams
group walk to the library before the exam
see who's heading the same way in the morning
dontUseWhen: where someone is right now (use come-find-me)

home.description: Where everyone starts: name and x, y in thousandths of the map (bottom-left is about 110, 860)

places.description: Up to 4 buildings people walk to, with x, y in thousandths of the map (keep them away from the middle, where the quad is)

people.description: Up to 6 walkers: which place (by name), class time as 24-hour '9:00', minutes to walk, who they already walk with (a name), and a note in their words
